answer: A ocean of per-task receipts records who did what, and the harbor of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. By the wharf of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
